security_audit.summary: The reviewed files are readable documentation and skill instructions, not obfuscated payloads. The main confirmed risks are third-party image upload, API key handling, hidden credential storage, temp-file outputs, and yescan or pip command execution. I found no evidence of prompt injection, hidden endpoints, or attempts to bypass the audit.

remediation.issue: External image and API key transmission
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user consent before processing, document retention terms, and warn users before submitting sensitive images.
Use user-only file permissions, support keychain or environment alternatives, and keep the rotation steps prominent.
Ask for user confirmation before pip installation or upgrade, and document the trusted package source and minimum version.
Offer a user-selected output directory and provide clear cleanup guidance for sensitive generated files.

content.value_statement: Image documents often need OCR, cleanup, or conversion before use. This skill routes image files or URLs through the yescan CLI for OCR, enhancement, document export, and ID photo generation.
actual_capabilities: Lists available yescan scenes and scene-specific parameters with yescan --list-scenes.
Runs OCR for images, including IDs, invoices, tables, handwriting, and formulas.
Enhances images with watermark, shadow, handwriting removal, correction, cropping, and HD enhancement.
Converts image inputs to Word, Excel, or PDF through supported CLI scenes.
Generates ID photo images and returns output file paths for generated assets.
Handles local file paths or HTTP and HTTPS image URLs, with one input source per run.
limitations: Requires the yescan Python package and a configured SCAN_WEBSERVICE_KEY.
Sends user-selected images to Quark Scan services for processing.
Handles images up to 5 MB and does not support video or pure text tasks.
Does not accept base64 input directly; base64 images must be saved as files first.

use_cases.title: Extract Text from Documents
use_cases.description: Extract readable text from IDs, invoices, handwriting, formulas, and scanned pages.

use_cases.title: Clean Scanned Images
use_cases.description: Remove shadows, marks, or watermarks from a user-provided image and return the saved result.

use_cases.title: Convert Image Tables
use_cases.description: Turn table images or document photos into Word, Excel, or PDF outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Run Basic OCR
prompt_templates.prompt: Use yescan to extract readable text from this image: [path or URL]. Show me the recognized text.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Document Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance this scanned image: [path]. Remove shadows and correct the page if supported. Return the output file path.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a Table Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this table image into an Excel document: [path]. Verify the conversion and give me the saved file path.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Step Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a yescan workflow for these images: [paths]. Identify needed scenes, ask about required parameters, run each step, and verify outputs.

output_examples.input: A user provides an invoice image and asks for OCR.
output_examples.output: The skill selects an OCR scene, runs yescan, and returns the extracted invoice text in readable form.

output_examples.input: A user asks to remove shadows from a photographed page.
output_examples.output: The skill runs an enhancement scene and reports the saved image path for the cleaned result.

output_examples.input: A user submits a table screenshot and needs a spreadsheet.
output_examples.output: The skill converts the image to a spreadsheet file and reports the document path.

best_practices: Confirm the image source and task before sending data to the external service.
Use current scene discovery output to choose scenes and parameters for the session.
Review images for sensitive data before processing them with third-party OCR services.
anti_patterns: Do not process images that the user did not explicitly provide.
Do not guess scene names or parameter values without current CLI output.
Do not report success until the CLI response and output path are verified.

faq.question: What does this skill process?
faq.answer: It processes image files and image URLs for OCR, enhancement, translation, conversion, and ID photo generation.

faq.question: Does it work without a yescan API key?
faq.answer: No. The yescan CLI needs a configured SCAN_WEBSERVICE_KEY before processing images.

faq.question: Where are processed files saved?
faq.answer: Image and document outputs are saved to temp directories or to a user-specified output directory.

faq.question: Does it send data outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. User-selected images and the API key are sent to Quark Scan services for processing.

faq.question: Can it process video or plain text?
faq.answer: No. The skill is limited to image inputs and related document outputs.

faq.question: Can it run in Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Claude Code, and Codex environments.
